cs.t: Cherry KC 4000: cheap, laptop-style, no num-pad and not ugly. I removed the annoyingly positioned fn-key (removed the rubber-dome and glued it down, so the felt edge of the keyboard is the ctrl key). I tried mechanical cherry brown keyswitches, but it wasn't for me. No num-pad and no fn, because my keyboard layout¹ has the numbers under my right hand when I hold a modifier. ¹  https://neo-layout.org/  (hover "Ebene 1/2/3/4" above diagram of the keyboard)
cs.th: Ask HN: What keyboard do you use to code?
